{{Recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Beverages|Beverages]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Algeria|Cuisine of Algeria]]

'''Cherbet Meliana''' ({{lang|ar|شربات مليانة}}) is a refreshing Algerian drink. As the name indicates, the drink originates from Meliana, a town located in Aïn Defla Province, northwestern Algeria, where it is considered a traditional drink. The consumption of the drink has considerably ceased due to the decrease of production of cherries in the region.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] of [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] cubes
* 1 glass of warm water
* 1 glass of pressed [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherry]] juice
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] of broken cherry pits

== Procedure ==
# Mix sugar cubes with warm water. Add cherry juice and broken pits.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat while skimming until the [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]] drips into a thin stream.
# Remove from heat and [[Cookbook:Strainer|strain]]. Bottle. Serve with sparkling or still water.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* This beverage can also be prepared with lemon, grape, or pomegranate juice.
